_comment: Embedding assets present in this build. Only regimes listed under 'assets' are fetched at startup; anything absent stays unavailable and falls back to regime 1. Keys are regime numbers (2 = word2vec bigrams, 3 = sentence transformer). Written by textanalysis/make_embedding_asset.py; 'dims' and 'count' here are informational only, the authoritative values come from the DMPE header.
